description: This file defines a utility enum 'SessionKey' with static functions for handling session key strings, including normalization, creation, and validation functions.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Returns a normalized session key, defaulting to 'main' if input is nil or empty.

methods.name: makeAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Creates a session key string for an agent, combining and trimming agent ID and base key.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a canonical main session key, i.e., 'global' or starting with 'agent:'.
